power.neoorigins.sporeling_mushroom_buff: Ṣe atunṣe ilera lakoko ti o wa ninu awọn biomes olu.
power.neoorigins.sporeling_fungal_contac: Larada 1 HP ni gbogbo iṣẹju nigba ti o duro lori tabi inu awọn bulọọki olu tabi mycelium.
power.neoorigins.sporeling_natural_armor: Resistance Yẹ I - idagbasoke olu lile rọ gbogbo fifun.
power.neoorigins.sporeling_daylight_dama: O gba ibajẹ 1 fun iṣẹju kan nigbati o farahan si imọlẹ orun taara.
origins.neoorigins.frostborn.name: Ojo tutu
origins.neoorigins.frostborn.description: Ohun akọkọ ti yinyin ati tutu - didi awọn ọta, ṣe rere ni taigas, ṣugbọn ina ati Nether jẹ iparun.
power.neoorigins.frostborn_freeze_aura.d: Blasts nitosi awọn ọta pẹlu awọn iwọn slowness. Awọn idiyele 2 stamina. 10-keji itutu.
power.neoorigins.frostborn_cold_buff.des: Gba agbara nigba ti o wa ni tutu taiga biomes.
power.neoorigins.frostborn_ice_walk.name: Yinyin Rin
power.neoorigins.frostborn_ice_walk.desc: Awọn aaye yinyin ni bulọki ti o nwo. 1-keji itutu.
power.neoorigins.frostborn_natural_armor: Yẹ Resistance I - crystallized yinyin deflects gbogbo fe.
power.neoorigins.frostborn_nether_damage: Mu 2 bibajẹ fun keji nigba ti Nether.
origins.neoorigins.strider.name: Strider
origins.neoorigins.strider.description: Ẹda abinibi ara ilu Nether ti o rin lori lava ti o mu larada ni igbona rẹ - ṣugbọn aye otutu ati omi ti n rọ.
power.neoorigins.strider_fire_immunity.d: Ajesara si ina, lava, awọn bulọọki magma, ati sisun.
power.neoorigins.strider_nether_buff.des: Gba igbelaruge iyara lakoko ti o wa ni Nether.
O gba ibajẹ 2 fun iṣẹju kan lakoko ti o wa ninu omi tabi ojo.
power.neoorigins.strider_lava_regen.name: Magma Ìgbàpadà
power.neoorigins.strider_lava_regen.desc: Larada 2 HP fun iṣẹju kan nigba ti submerged ni lava.
power.neoorigins.strider_night_vision.de: Le ri kedere ninu òkunkun pipe. Yipada pẹlu bọtini Iran Alẹ (aiyipada K).
power.neoorigins.strider_natural_armor.d: Yẹ Resistance I - magma-lile ara shrugs ni pipa ipa.
origins.neoorigins.siren.name: Siren
origins.neoorigins.siren.description: An aromiyo enchantress ti a bi ni ìmọ òkun - ẹwa eda pẹlu ohun alluring niwaju ati ki o aláìsan ninu awọn tides, sugbon frail, o lọra, ati ki o ibinujẹ jade lori ilẹ.
power.neoorigins.siren_charm.name: Alluring Wiwa
power.neoorigins.siren_charm.description: Gbogbo awọn onijagidijagan foju rẹ ayafi ti o ba kọlu wọn ni akọkọ.
power.neoorigins.siren_water_breathing.d: Nmi labẹ omi lainidi ati rii ni kedere nipasẹ omi laisi kurukuru.
power.neoorigins.siren_aquatic_speed.des: We Elo yiyara ju kan deede player.
power.neoorigins.siren_night_vision.name: Okun Oju
power.neoorigins.siren_night_vision.desc: Le ri kedere ninu awọn dudu ogbun. Yipada pẹlu bọtini Iran Alẹ (aiyipada K).
power.neoorigins.siren_reduced_health.de: -2 ọkàn (-4 max HP). Slender, orin-itumọ ti - ko ṣe fun awọn fifun.
power.neoorigins.siren_regen_in_water.de: Larada 1 HP fun iṣẹju kan lakoko ti o wa ninu omi.
power.neoorigins.siren_dries_out.name: Gbigbe Jade
power.neoorigins.siren_dries_out.descrip: Afẹfẹ ami si isalẹ nigba ti o ba jade ninu omi: dada gun ju ati awọn ti o suffocate. Ojo, cauldron omi kan, Mimi omi tabi omi ti nṣiṣe lọwọ ti o wa nitosi gbogbo wọn mu kuro.
origins.neoorigins.piglin.name: Piglin
origins.neoorigins.piglin.description: Jagunjagun Nether ti o ni ifẹ afẹju goolu - alagbara ni ile, ti o bẹru nipasẹ ibatan, ṣugbọn ailera ni ita Nether.
power.neoorigins.piglin_nether_buff.name: Ibinu Nether
power.neoorigins.piglin_nether_buff.desc: Awọn anfani Agbara II lakoko ti o wa ni Nether.
power.neoorigins.piglin_gold_affinity.de: Piglins ati Piglin Brutes kii yoo kọlu ọ.
power.neoorigins.piglin_fire_immunity.de: Ajesara si ina, lava, awọn bulọọki magma, ati gbogbo ibajẹ sisun.
power.neoorigins.piglin_attack_bonus.des: Awọn adehun 2 afikun bibajẹ fun buruju.
power.neoorigins.piglin_overworld_weakne: Ibanujẹ pẹlu Ailagbara lakoko ti o wa ni agbaye.
power.neoorigins.piglin_night_vision.des: Le ri kedere ninu okunkun. Yipada pẹlu bọtini Iran Alẹ (aiyipada K).
power.neoorigins.piglin_soul_fire_damage: Ọkàn iná Burns jinle - gba 0,5 bibajẹ fun keji nigba ti a Soul iyanrin Valley.
origins.neoorigins.hiveling.name: Hiveling
origins.neoorigins.hiveling.description: Kòkòrò tó dà bí oyin tó máa ń fò lómìnira, tó ń ta àwọn ọ̀tá jà pẹ̀lú ìkọlù olóró, tó sì ń fọwọ́ sowọ́ pọ̀ láti hù. Awọn iyẹ ẹlẹgẹ ati ebi ailopin jẹ idiyele ọkọ ofurufu.
power.neoorigins.hiveling_flight.name: Buzzing Iyẹ
power.neoorigins.hiveling_flight.descrip: Glide bi olumulo elytra - awọn iyẹ oyin lu sare. Tẹ fo nigba ti o ṣubu lati ya kuro.
power.neoorigins.hiveling_sting.name: Òró Òró
power.neoorigins.hiveling_sting.descript: Ina boluti oloro si ibi-afẹde rẹ. Awọn idiyele 1 agbara. 6-keji itutu.
power.neoorigins.hiveling_crop_growth.de: Awọn irugbin ti o wa nitosi dagba ni iyara pupọ ni iwaju rẹ.
power.neoorigins.hiveling_size.name: Fireemu Kekere
power.neoorigins.hiveling_size.descripti: 60% awọn iwọn ti a deede player.
power.neoorigins.hiveling_entity_group.d: Classified bi ohun arthropod - jẹ ipalara si Bane of Arthropods.
power.neoorigins.hiveling_jump_boost.des: + 40% fo agbara - awọn ẹsẹ oyin orisun omi ti o ga julọ.
power.neoorigins.hiveling_reduced_health: -3 ọkàn (-6 max HP). Awọn iyẹ ẹlẹgẹ, fireemu ẹlẹgẹ.
power.neoorigins.hiveling_hunger_drain.d: Burns agbara 50% yiyara - fò jẹ rẹwẹsi.
origins.neoorigins.cinderborn.name: Omo bibi
origins.neoorigins.cinderborn.descriptio: Ipilẹ ina folkano - ajesara si ina, ẹru si awọn ẹranko, ti o mu larada nipasẹ lava - ṣugbọn omi bajẹ.
power.neoorigins.cinderborn_fire_immunit: Ajesara si ina, lava, awọn bulọọki magma, ati sisun - ileru kan wọ awọ ara rẹ.
power.neoorigins.cinderborn_fireball.des: Da bi nwaye ti awọn bọọlu ina 4 si itọsọna ti o n wa. Awọn idiyele 3 stamina. 5-keji itutu.
power.neoorigins.cinderborn_natural_armo: Resistance Yẹ I - tutu magma pamọ yipada awọn ohun ija kuro.
power.neoorigins.cinderborn_lava_regen.d: Larada 1 HP fun iseju kan nigba ti submerged ni lava.
Awọn anfani Agbara lakoko ti o wa ni Nether - ile ile fọwọkan ina.
power.neoorigins.cinderborn_water_weakne: Omi jẹ majele - gba ibajẹ 1.5 fun iṣẹju kan lakoko ti o wa ninu omi tabi ojo.
power.neoorigins.cinderborn_night_vision: Iná inú ń tan ìmọ́lẹ̀ àní àwọn ihò tí ó dúdú jùlọ. Yipada pẹlu bọtini Iran Alẹ (aiyipada K).
power.neoorigins.cinderborn_scare_mobs.d: Pupọ julọ awọn ẹda palolo - ẹran-ọsin, awọn ara abule, ẹranko igbẹ - sá niwaju didan rẹ.
origins.neoorigins.sculkborn.name: Sculkborn
origins.neoorigins.sculkborn.description: A jije ti awọn jin dudu - armored, sooro, ati Ologun pẹlu sonic agbara - sugbon o lọra, frail ni orun, ati ailera loke ilẹ.
power.neoorigins.sculkborn_sonic_bolt.de: Ina a pupo sonic boluti ti o deba ni a 7-Blocki rediosi. Awọn idiyele 2 stamina. 6-keji itutu.
power.neoorigins.sculkborn_darkness_aura: Ina a sonic polusi ti o fi oju kan duro aaye ti òkunkun ni awọn oniwe-ji. Awọn idiyele 3 stamina. 15-keji itutu.
Ṣe akiyesi agbaye nipasẹ awọn gbigbọn - okunkun kii ṣe idiwọ. Yipada pẹlu bọtini Iran Alẹ (aiyipada K).
power.neoorigins.sculkborn_natural_armor: Yẹ Resistance I - ipon sculk plating fa ti nwọle bibajẹ.
power.neoorigins.sculkborn_daylight_dama: O gba ibajẹ 2 fun iṣẹju kan nigbati o farahan si imọlẹ orun taara.
power.neoorigins.sculkborn_projectile_im: Awọn itọka ti wa ni pipa nipasẹ awọn aaye gbigbọn.
power.neoorigins.sculkborn_vibration_sen: Awọn nkan alãye ti o wa nitosi nmọlẹ - o lero gbigbe wọn nipasẹ ilẹ.
power.neoorigins.sculkborn_reduced_healt: -2 ọkàn (-4 max HP). A ara idaji-ṣe ti sculk ni brittle.
origins.neoorigins.enderite.name: Enderite
origins.neoorigins.enderite.description: A bi ti Ipari - titunto si ti teleportation ati phasing, graceful ni iran, ṣugbọn jẹ ipalara si omi ati if'oju.
power.neoorigins.enderite_teleport.name: Igbesẹ Warp
power.neoorigins.enderite_teleport.descr: Tẹlifoonu to awọn bulọọki 32 ni itọsọna ti o n wa. Awọn idiyele 2 agbara. 3-keji itutu.
power.neoorigins.enderite_phase.name: Alakoso ofo
power.neoorigins.enderite_phase.descript: Awọn ipele nipasẹ ri to Odi. Awọn idiyele 3 agbara. 10-keji itutu.
power.neoorigins.enderite_slow_fall.name: Isubu Ender lọra
power.neoorigins.enderite_slow_fall.desc: Ṣubu oore-ọfẹ, bi ẹnipe agbara walẹ ko kan.
power.neoorigins.enderite_night_vision.d: Le ri kedere ninu òkunkun pipe. Yipada pẹlu bọtini Iran Alẹ (aiyipada K).
power.neoorigins.enderite_scare_endermit: Endermites ati silverfish sá loju oju.
power.neoorigins.enderite_water_damage.d: Mu 2 bibajẹ fun iṣẹju kan lati olubasọrọ pẹlu omi tabi ojo.
power.neoorigins.enderite_daylight_weakn: O gba 50% ibajẹ diẹ sii lakoko ti o farahan si imọlẹ oorun.
